summary: Shiftin backend+frontend tested. 25/26 backend pytest tests pass against public URL. Welcome, Login, Worker home, Business dashboard, Create-Job FAB all render correctly in mobile viewport (375x667). Found: (1) CRITICAL backend bug — jobs are marked 'filled' after the FIRST take even when more slots remain (frontend shows 'Terisi Penuh' badge on 1/2 and 2/3 jobs). (2) Emergent object storage integration returns 400 Bad Request on init so POST /api/upload fails with 502. All other flows (auth, role enforcement, profile auto-verify, nearby feed+skill filter, job detail, take shift FCFS + duplicate 409 + time-conflict 409, server-side geofence rejection, mock-location rejection, create-job past-date 400 + success, business dashboard tabs, applications list, notifications list/unread/read-all, favorites add/list/remove, wallet, profile) work.

critical.issue: Status prematurely set to 'filled' after FIRST slot is taken. Code uses `claimed['slots_filled'] + 1 >= workers_needed` but motor's find_one_and_update(return_document=True) already returns the AFTER-increment document. Fix: compare `claimed['slots_filled'] >= claimed['workers_needed']` (no +1). Repro: login bisnis@shiftin.id → GET /api/jobs/business?tab=active returns status='filled' for 1/2 and 2/3 jobs. File: /app/backend/server.py:649

Emergent object storage returns 400 Bad Request on init: `storage init failed: 400 Client Error for url: https://integrations.emergentagent.com/objstore/api/v1/storage/init`. All uploads return 502 'Gagal mengunggah berkas'. Blocks selfie check-in, outlet photo, KTP upload flows. Check /app/backend/storage.py configuration and APP_NAME. May require web_search for integration setup.

minor.issue: The seeded job for 'today' can have already ended by the time of testing (WIB offset). Consider seeding only future jobs or auto-expiring open jobs whose end_dt < now.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'Terisi Penuh' badge for jobs with remaining slots (consequence of backend bug above, not a frontend bug per se)

integration_issues.issue: Login as budi@shiftin.id shows empty feed because the only remaining open-and-matching jobs are already marked 'filled' due to the backend bug

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents`. Minor but should be migrated. Likely coming from a child component in Welcome/Login screens.

action_items: FIX backend: In /app/backend/server.py:649 inside take_shift, change `if claimed['slots_filled'] + 1 >= claimed['workers_needed']` to `if claimed['slots_filled'] >= claimed['workers_needed']` because return_document=True returns the AFTER doc.
FIX storage: Investigate why Emergent object storage init returns 400. Check APP_NAME/env config in /app/backend/storage.py. Upload endpoint currently non-functional (502).
OPTIONAL: Auto-expire open jobs whose end_dt < now so businesses don't see stale rows, or filter them from the 'active' tab.
OPTIONAL: Replace deprecated `pointerEvents` prop with `style.pointerEvents` to clear the React Native web warning.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of empty worker feed & 'Terisi Penuh' labels: In server.py take_shift() the condition `claimed['slots_filled'] + 1 >= claimed['workers_needed']` is evaluated against the AFTER-increment document returned by motor's find_one_and_update(return_document=True). After the first worker takes a slot, slots_filled is already incremented to 1 in `claimed`, so for a 2-worker job it computes 1+1>=2 → True → status is set to 'filled'. Any subsequent nearby_jobs query filters out jobs with status!='open', hence empty feed. Fix: drop the `+ 1`.
